explainer: Template used to adapt the general prompt library to one specific project without changing the reusable prompts.
how_it_works: The user copies this template, fills project variables, records source scope and validation commands, then uses the profile to assemble project-specific prompt stacks.

files_created.purpose: Human-readable project profile derived from this template.
Machine-readable project variables for stack assembly.

risks: Project-specific facts may accidentally be copied into reusable prompt bodies.
A profile may be mistaken for source truth.
mitigations: Keep project-specific facts in profiles and variables only.
State that source files, logs, and validation output outrank profile text.
safe_usage: Use this template to create a project profile before assembling prompts for a specific project.
example_usage: Create a profile for a project by replacing placeholders such as <PROJECT_ROOT> and <PRODUCT_PACKAGE>.
